name: Yamabuki Kuon
source: Kuon is in her first year in high school and is Touki’s kouhai. A cute and lively underclassman, she honestly expresses what she feels. She loves and admires Ayumi, to the point where she follows her around at every opportunity that arises. Kuon is pretty silly and weird at times and happens to love cute things. During her free time, she helps out at her mother's café.
